
```{r}
# Define combinations
combinations <- expand.grid(
  dataset = dataset,
  metadata = metadata,
  outcome_colname = outcome_colname,
  #group_colname = group_colname,
  method = method,
  scale_method = scale_method,
  impute_method = impute_method,
  val = val,
  preprocess_methods = preprocess_methods,
  filter_features = filter_features,
  fs_method = fs_method
  #feature_importance_method = feature_importance_method 
)
```


```{r}
# remove variables that are not compatible with each other
apply_conditions <- function(cb_grid) {
  # removes rows that use clr with null imputation method
  out <- cb_grid[!(cb_grid$scale_method == "clr" & is.null(cb_grid$impute_method)), ]
  # removes rows that use rclr with imputation methods other than null
  out <- out[!(out$scale_method == "rclr" & !is.null(out$impute_method)), ]
  # removes rows that don't use pseudo and use min or 1
  out <- out[!(out$impute_method != "pseudo" & (out$val == "min" | out$val == 1)), ]
  return(out)
}
```


```{r}
# iterate through each set of variables in the combination grid and runs the ML pipeline on them
pipeline_iteration <- function(cb_grid) {
  out <- apply(cb_grid, 1, function(x) 
    run_ml_cv(
      dataset = x$dataset,
      metadata = x$metadata,
      method = x$method,
      outcome_colname = x$outcome_colname,
      group_colname = x$group_colname,
      scale_method = list(x$scale_method, x$impute_method, x$val),
      preprocess_methods = x$preprocess_methods,
      corrFunList = list(corr_method = "spearman", corr_thresh = 0.95, group_neg_corr = TRUE),
      filter_features = x$filter_features,
      filterFunList = list(test = x$fs),
      resamp_method = "repeatedcv", 
      kfold = 10,
      cv_times = 10,
      training_frac = 0.80,
      hyperparameters = NULL,
      cross_val = NULL,
      perf_metric_function = NULL,
      perf_metric_name = NULL,
      group_partitions = NULL,
      class_weight = F,
      find_feature_importance = FALSE,
      feature_importance_method = c("permutation", "embedded"),
      jobs = 1,
      threads = 1,
      seed = 0))
  return(out)
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
new_comb <- apply_conditions(combinations)
rd_samp <- sample(rownames(new_comb), 3)
cb_grid <- new_comb[rd_samp,]
out <- pipeline_iteration(cb_grid)
out
```
